limitation: A beneficial sensory contrast is insufficient for navigation. Readout uses arbitrary release-to-velocity scaling and fixed birth offset; forward channels DNg100 are silent and forward motion is tonic.

rivals.A: Explicit calibrated neural-to-actuator port: offset and scale derived only from an odor-free calibration record; common interface independent of CNS engine. Test transport before any organism integration.
rivals.B: Preserve the reader and change upstream neural processing/population recruitment after identifying a failed layer using signed consumed flow; not a gain change.
rivals.C: Joint descending control of forward motion and steering: audit the locomotor channels and their interaction before assuming tonic advance is neural navigation. No target-bearing or source position enters a controller.

operation: One new functional readout hypothesis: u=5*tanh((qL-qR-mu_rest)/sigma_rest) deg/s. Fixed mu/sigma from first200ms of an existing sham trial. Preserve DN IDs10118L/10065R and 1ms consumed samples. No training on odor labels, pose, bearing, source location or commanded target. Endpoint baseline reset is diagnostic only, not a promoted candidate.
information: Exposed historical recordings only. This is an exploratory screening, not a blind confirmation or biological fit; calibration data are separate from the evaluation samples.

readout.input_units: dimensionless model release q; not firing rate or calcium

prediction: A rest-scaled port will transfer direction and sustain material directional signal without material new rest drift; failure rejects this normalization, not all calibrated ports.

screen.notes: The0.02deg margin is a prospective material command screen, not an error bound or navigation threshold. No retuning after failure.
